title: Split auth deps into runtime profiles and upgrade legacy OpenSSL bindings
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Background: Our token validation and SSO stack currently pulls a large, monolithic set of crypto and SAML dependencies into every runtime. This increases image size, slows cold-starts, and makes security upgrades risky because a single bump touches hosted, dedicated, and private deployment code paths. The goal of this ticket is to: 1) introduce explicit runtime dependency profiles (minimal-runtime, compliance-runtime) so we only install heavier crypto/SAML libraries where required; 2) upgrade legacy OpenSSL native bindings used by the token parsing layer to OpenSSL 3.1-compatible builds and remove brittle C-extension shims; 3) refactor the synchronous token verification hot path to reduce blocking IO and lower P99 latency.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Two runtime profiles are supported and selectable via image tags or ENV (MINIMAL_RUNTIME / COMPLIANCE_RUNTIME). 2) All services on MINIMAL_RUNTIME do not include xmlsec or legacy OpenSSL C shims and pass the integrated auth test-suite. 3) COMPLIANCE_RUNTIME images include OpenSSL 3.1-compatible bindings + streaming XML parser and pass FIPS-like test vectors in the CI matrix. 4) Auth P99 latency reduced by at least 15% on a canonical workload after refactor. 5) Security review completed and CVE baseline artifacts added to the release notes.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Upgrading native OpenSSL bindings may break token signatures in older customer integrations. Mitigation: Add a compatibility shim that supports legacy token formats with a feature flag and a migration mode (logs + metric) that surfaces mismatches. Risk: Image size increase for compliance runtime. Mitigation: keep MINIMAL_RUNTIME images <150MB increase by stripping debug symbols and using selective wheel installs. Risk: SAML parsing regressions can introduce DoS vectors. Mitigation: replace DOM-based parsing with streaming validator and add size/time quotas in parser config.
work_items: Create new docker build profiles and CI matrix entries (MINIMAL_RUNTIME, COMPLIANCE_RUNTIME)
Refactor token verifier to async path: move file/IO and crypto init off the request loop
Upgrade OpenSSL bindings and rebuild wheels for linux-musl and linux-glibc images
Introduce a lightweight shim for legacy token encoding formats and add migration logs
Swap xmlsec-based SAML validation for streaming parser with enforced quotas
Add unit and integration tests (token fuzzing, signature vectors, SAML large-xml testcases)
Run staged rollout: canary on internal dedicated pool -> external Beta customers -> full rollout
Coordinate with Platform and Deploy teams for image naming and upgrade windows
updates: 2026-02-06: Kickoff meeting with Security, Platform, and SRE. Decided on two-profile approach to reduce blast radius when upgrading native deps.
2026-02-13: Spike complete for async verifier — PoC shows 18% P99 improvement in local harness. PoC PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/10872
2026-02-20: Built compliance-runtime image with OpenSSL 3.1 bindings. Ran full test vectors — 3 failures remain for legacy ECDSA token edge-case; added to compatibility shim backlog.
2026-02-28: Security review drafted — initial comments request additional fuzzing and reproducible build artifacts. Assigned to SRE for reproducible build pipeline task.

2026-03-04: Streaming SAML parser integrated into auth-service branch; initial benchmarks show memory peak reduced by 40% on large assertion payloads. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/2276
next_steps: 1) Address remaining ECDSA edge-case in compatibility shim (2d). 2) Add reproducible build step for OpenSSL wheels (3d). 3) Expand CI matrix to include MINIMAL_RUNTIME acceptance tests and run overnight. 4) Schedule canary rollout during low-traffic window and prepare rollback runbook.
notes: Related: this ticket intentionally avoids changing SSO UX; it only restructures server-side dependency surface and runtime selection.
Coordination required with Customer Success for Beta customers that opt into COMPLIANCE_RUNTIME; prepare communication template and opt-in form.
Metric: add 'auth.legacy_token_mismatch' and 'auth.verifier_p99_ms' to telemetry and dashboard before canary rollout.
